rules.check: Selected donor must already contain every requested component type and quantity. No cloning is allowed.
rules.implementation_hint: Use exact trusted donor manifest counts and verified component packets, not file names or string evidence.

rules.check: Delete component body plus linked ref/model/name/value text, wires, terminals, junctions, CDB rows, and device metadata for every deleted component.
rules.implementation_hint: Require a component linkage map before deletion mutation is allowed.

rules.check: Every kept component must retain a non-empty valid Proteus model/device field.
rules.implementation_hint: Catch Proteus 'No model specified for ...' failures before output.

rules.check: Component references and CDB internal IDs must be unique after deletion/mutation.
rules.implementation_hint: Catch duplicate part reference and duplicate CDB ID failures before output.

rules.check: After deletion no unsupported donor extras may remain.
rules.implementation_hint: Compare kept inventory with the normalized component request.

rules.check: When a component body moves, its reference/model/name/value text and pin anchors must move by the same delta.
rules.implementation_hint: Compare relative offsets before and after beautification.

rules.check: Reserved names V0/G0/VCC/GND/+5V/0 may only be supply/ground, never internal refs or output nets.
rules.implementation_hint: Apply to component refs, terminal labels, wire labels, and generated net names.

rules.check: Every accepted fixed bug must become a validator_history_rules.json entry plus a regression test.
rules.implementation_hint: Treat user-reported Proteus failures as permanent regression evidence.
